column1: # Rows db.ung.* (line NP, O4b): BLASTP -ungapped -comp_based_stats 0 with -db: the 4 queries of tests/fasta/outfmt0/sc4a_q.faa (the second without hits) against paja (each query's ungapped Karlin-Altschul block with the database's length and number of sequences; blast_setup.c:517-527), outfmt 6, 7, 0, 8 (one Dense-diag per HSP), 11 and 16, with a hit list of 5 for all but outfmt 6.

# Rows db.ung.len0.* (line NP, O4b): the same with an ungapped HSP of length 0 among the shown hits, against tests/db_search/len0_l0015 (the subject of tests/fasta/outfmt0/len0_l0015_s.faa; tests/db_search/README.md), outfmt 6 with custom fields and 0.

# Rows db.ung.sw.* (line NP, O4b2-2): -ungapped -comp_based_stats 0 -use_sw_tback, on which NCBI crashes at the traceback of every query batch it searches (PD-LOSAT-NCBI-DEFECTS 1.83, the form of 1.76 and 1.79): batches without a valid context (a query of only X, masked whole by -seg yes or -lcase_masking; a query without letters) are reported and not searched, so a run of such batches only ends as NCBI's (ncbi rows), and LOSAT refuses at the first searched batch after the reports of the batches before (losat-rejection rows: no stdout when the first batch is searched, else the first bytes of the anchor without -use_sw_tback up to the second batch's report, or in outfmt 5 and 16 NCBI's run whose second batch fails before its report, db.ung.sw.invempty.b1.*); queries tests/fasta/o4b2, database tests/db_search/x16_taxid; freeze them alone with `freeze --program blastp --only db.ung.sw.`.
